rotowire.headline: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
rotowire.story: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. He was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four regular-season appearances.
rotowire.description: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

fantasy.projection: Edwards set new career bests in scoring (28.8 PPG) and field goal percentage (48.9 FG%) last season and could be set to improve on both marks this season after the Timberwolves traded for point guard LaMelo Ball. Edwards has never played next to an offense creator and facilitator of Ball's caliber, so he should get better looks and easier opportunities this season than he's ever had. Edwards has clear 30+ PPG upside and should again be among the league leaders in 3-pointers made.
